items.title: Video shows men who attended Khamenei's funeral and the man who didn't
items.description: The strictly choreographed funeral of Iran's former supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has presented a rare insight into the image Tehran wants to project to the world and the men they see as central to it.

items.title: How this school cracked the code to close the gap in early reading
items.description: An inspiring turnaround at an Aboriginal community school could provide a scalable solution for closing the gap on Indigenous literacy.

items.title: PBS dispute could see MS patients pay $33k a year for crucial drugs
items.description: The latest PBS stoush with drugmakers means thousands of people with MS are at risk of being forced to pay $33,000 a year for lifesaving medication.

items.title: Huge arms deals struck at NATO, but Trump 'disappointed' with leaders
items.description: In a sign they are heeding calls from the United States to spend more to defend Europe, NATO leaders agree to deals estimated to be worth at least $72 billion.

items.title: Live: Messi leads incredible Argentina comeback as Egypt blows 2-0 lead
items.description: Lionel Messi guides Argentina to an incredible comeback win against Egypt, coming back from 2-0 down to steal a 3-2 win at the death. Follow live.

items.title: Farage quits as an MP but vows to win 'circus' by-election
items.description: Nigel Farage, the far-right political leader riding a surge of support in Britain, has announced a major gamble that could end his political career.

items.title: Prince Harry loses privacy case against Daily Mail, calls ruling 'whitewash'
items.description: Prince Harry and six other claimants, including singer Elton John, have lost their claims against Daily Mail's publisher after alleging their phones were tapped, voicemails intercepted and personal information obtained through deception.

items.title: Marine Le Pen to enter French presidential race as court trims ban
items.description: The court in Paris upheld Marine Le Pen's conviction for misusing EU funds but shortened her ban on running for elected office.

items.title: Monaco bomb suspect found dead near Kyiv
items.description: A Ukrainian woman suspected of a bomb attack that targeted a wealthy Ukrainian-born businessman in Monaco has been found shot dead in Ukraine, according to Ukraine's prosecutor general's office.

items.title: Qantas customers warned not to delete email about $105m settlement
items.description: More than 1 million Qantas customers are being notified they may be eligible for access to a multi-million-dollar settlement.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
